Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno Bhagavantaṃ vanditvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
Tatra kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi:
Idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ—
Ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā
Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ—sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.
Adinnādānā veramaṇī sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.
Kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.
Suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho.

Dānaṃ dadamānā sīlāni rakkhamānā
manussā sagge uppajjanti.
Sace bhikkhu sīlaṃ rakkheyya, sukhī assa.
